Subject: Staged PO stitch + onboarding recertification for renewal term uplift

Hi Samantha / Globex procurement team —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. As we discussed during the renewal review, Globex is planning a term uplift and a modest capacity increase for Q4 usage. To keep the renewal timeline tight we're proposing a two-step procurement path: (1) a short-staged PO (30% of uplift) to cover onboarding re-cert activities and the initial capacity bump, and (2) the full-term PO to be issued once procurement portal approvals finish and the new SOW is countersigned.

Action items I can help with:
- Share the final SOW (attached) with your legal and procurement intake.
- Provide a screenshot and step-by-step for the procurement portal fields that often cause delays (see attached).
- Loop in our billing team if you need a separate invoice flow for the staged PO.

Could you confirm whether a staged PO is acceptable for Globex and the expected procurement SLA (e.g., 7–10 business days once submitted)? If staged PO is not allowed, we’ll prioritize getting the full PO template ready and can request an exec exception.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

— Monica
Monica Patel

Hi Monica —

Thanks for the clear breakdown and for the attachments. Procurement is generally OK with a two-step approach for renewals under $250k, so the staged PO approach should be workable. A couple notes from our side:

- We need the SOW to explicitly call out the onboarding activities that the staged PO will cover (training, evidence handoff, and the first two weeks of elevated capacity). If you can add a one-paragraph appendix it will simplify legal review.
- Our portal requires an internal GL code and an approver alias (see the screenshot you attached) — I’ll send the precise fields to the portal intake address when we submit.
- Estimated SLA: 10 business days from portal submission to PO issuance for staged PO; full PO usually takes 3–4 weeks due to budget committee review.

I’ll coordinate with Henry on the GL codes and loop procurement. Expect a portal ticket from enterprise-purchasing@globex.com today.

Best,
Samantha Ortiz
Senior Purchasing Manager — Global Accounts
Globex Corp
